zh-CN.title: 城市纪念冰箱贴重绘
items: 四座城市换上独立设计的珐琅旅行纪念冰箱贴
实体金属质感替代旧城市背景的局部裁切
移除多余城市圆章，挂件与气泡边缘更协调

en.title: City souvenir magnets redrawn
items: Four cities now feature independently designed enamel travel magnets
Tactile metal souvenirs replace cropped fragments of old backgrounds
Extra city badges are removed for a cleaner bubble-edge composition
